comment: Some initial comments for this mapping:2.1 first column - revise to "high-quality workforce data for planning, deployment and shortage mapping"2.2 - can include some description on the lines of "Payroll data can inform reporting on NHWA indicators on expenditure for compensation, entry-level wages and salaries, and pay gaps".2.3 "cross-border verification informed by the WHO Global Code of Practice on International Recruitment" I don't the Code recommends any such verification, need to cross-check and revise language.2.4 last column - replace "ISCO or competency taxonomies" with "ISCED taxonomy"Reference 1 should be 2023, not 2024.Reference 3 is now being updated, will be published soon.
